title: Continuing Professional Training 2026 for accredited auditors

sections.heading: Continuing Professional Training 2026 for accredited auditors

paras.text: The continuing professional training programme for 2026 will take place in person at the premises of the FSMA (rue du Congrès/Congresstraat 12-14, 1000 Brussels). The programme is spread over two sessions on:
paras.loc: Continuing Professional Training 2026 for accredited auditors, para 1

paras.text: Thursday 19 November 2026 from 2 pm to 5 pm: training session for institutions for occupational retirement provision ;
paras.loc: Continuing Professional Training 2026 for accredited auditors, para 2

paras.text: Tuesday 24 November 2026 from 2 pm to 5 pm: training session for undertakings for collective investment, management companies of undertakings for collective investment and regulated real estate companies .
paras.loc: Continuing Professional Training 2026 for accredited auditors, para 3

paras.text: You can register for these continuing professional training sessions via the Event application of the FSMA , where you can log in using your eID or Itsme. Registrations will close on Wednesday 21 October 2026. Registration is free.
paras.loc: Continuing Professional Training 2026 for accredited auditors, para 4

paras.text: Find out more in our Communication FSMA_2026_17 (available in French - Dutch only)
paras.loc: Continuing Professional Training 2026 for accredited auditors, para 5
